guide.title: How to Set Up Your OpenAI API Key
guide.subtitle: A simple step-by-step guide to get your AI-powered training programs working.
guide.whatTitle: What is an OpenAI API key?
guide.whatDesc: An API key is like a password that lets Shuttle Lab talk to OpenAI's AI on your behalf. When you ask Shuttle Lab to create a training program, it sends your request to OpenAI, which generates the program. The API key tells OpenAI that the request is coming from your account.
guide.whyDesc: Shuttle Lab uses OpenAI's AI to create personalized badminton training programs. Your API key is needed to:
guide.whyPoint1: Generate training programs based on your chosen theme and intensity
guide.whyPoint2: Get smart suggestions for your next training focus
guide.whyPoint3: Create programs with the right number of progression levels
guide.costDesc: Yes! Shuttle Lab itself is completely free to use. The only cost is what OpenAI charges for using their AI. Each training program generation costs roughly $0.01 to $0.05 (a few cents). You can set a spending limit on your OpenAI account so you never spend more than you want.
guide.costNote: You can also use Shuttle Lab without an API key — just create custom programs using our built-in templates at no cost at all.
guide.stepsTitle: How to get your API key (5 easy steps)
guide.step1Desc: Go to platform.openai.com and sign up for a free account. You can use your Google or Microsoft account to sign up quickly.
guide.step2Desc: Go to Settings > Billing in your OpenAI account. Add a credit or debit card. You can set a monthly spending limit (even as low as $5) so there are no surprises.
guide.step3Desc: Go to Settings > API Keys in your OpenAI account. Click "Create new secret key", give it a name like "Shuttle Lab", and click Create. Your key will start with "sk-".
guide.step4Desc: Copy the key right away — OpenAI will only show it once. If you lose it, you can always create a new one.
guide.step5Desc: Go to Settings in Shuttle Lab and paste your key in the OpenAI API Key field. Click Save, and you're all set!
guide.safetyPoint1: Your key is stored only in your browser session — we never save it to any database or share it with anyone.
guide.safetyPoint2: You can delete or change your key anytime from your OpenAI account.
guide.safetyPoint3: Set a spending limit on your OpenAI account to stay in control of costs.
